name: David
source:
A man who runs the inn "Magnolia" in a village near Plato. Susie's father.

He's blunt, but he's just as kind as his daughter.

He is also the parent of the Saki brothers, Jean, and Mikado.

"What do you cook with rice? Will you eat it?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official wesbite[/url]]
